en: Ah, Shuichi, you're here.
Shuichi! We do this together!
Huh? You're here too, Gonta?
Gonta wanna help Himiko!
Help?

Himiko decide to work hard, and live for
Angie and Tenko's sake, right?
Gonta very moved by Himiko's feelings!

So Gonta wanna help Himiko stay positive!
Gonta wanna be useful, even just a little!
I don't need any help...
...Huh? No?
Urk—!

N-No...well, maybe you can help me 
just a little.
Really? Gonta can help with something!?
U-Um...
Tell Gonta! Gonta do anything for Himiko!
Nyeeeh...let's see...
<CLT=cltMIND>Why are you looking at *me*?
What wrong? You being modest?
You no gotta be modest! We friends!
I-I know that! You tell him, Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>I knew you were gonna make
me do this!
Shuichi, how can Gonta help?

Ah, um, perhaps we should
work out together?
Together? That all? Really, Himiko?
Y-Yeah! R-Really!

The exercises I'm about to do aren't regular
exercises. They're for mage training.

So that means, I need mana 
to move my body.

Mah-nah? What that? Gonta not smart
boy, so Gonta not understand!

Uh...erm...basically, it's energy.
I need a lot of energy to use magic.

And the best way to get that energy is by having
someone with overflowing vitality nearby.
Sorry! Gonta still not understand!

Gonta, you have a lot of vitality, so I want
your help giving some of that to Himiko.
...And that help Himiko?
Uh, yeah. It'll help a lot.
Okay! Then Gonta train with Himiko too!
Shuichi, let's work hard for Himiko!
Y-Yeah!

We haven't even started and I'm 
already tired...

<CLT=cltMIND>After changing into our keikogi,
we began training under Himiko.

Next up, we're gonna do 100 cool 
magic show poses!

Follow along after me!
Don't forget to smile for the audience!
Yes!
O-Okay...
One! Two! Three!
One! Two! Three!

<CLT=cltMIND>We practiced waving our wands and
straddling broomsticks 100 times...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's honestly...difficult to
comment on...

What's the matter, Shuichi!?
You're slacking on your poses!

It important to smile, too!
Smile like Gonta! Smile like gentleman!
S-Sure.

One more time, from the top!
One! Two! Three!

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko is more lively than
I've ever seen her.

<CLT=cltMIND>All the anger and sadness... She's trying
to deal with all of that in her own way.

<CLT=cltMIND>Hey, Tenko...
Can you see Himiko from wherever you are?
<CLT=cltMIND>You've reached her, Tenko.

<CLT=cltMIND>Still sweating from all the training,
I returned to my room.
